cloud_model.description: Cloud model for reads the on-device model hands up, and the hybrid fallback. Change it here, not in a release.

chart_bound.description: Which end of the Food Banks Canada chart's printed range this food bank uses: min (cautious) or max.

chart_overrides.description: Per-category limits that replace the chart's, e.g. {"canned_fruit_veg":{"rule":"months","value":18}} for a food bank that shares canned goods to 18 months.

food_bank_id.description: Firestore document id of the food bank this deployment logs to.

food_bank_name.description: Shown at the top of the sort screen.
